title: Conversational
description: Relaxed, natural, like talking to a friend across the table.

sample: So here's the thing nobody tells you about passwords. [chuckle] Most of them are terrible. Not yours, obviously. Yours is great. But the average one? It's basically the word password with a one at the end. And that's the whole reason this stuff matters.
